fckGKV6HXoCg.text: @Von Thünen@, @Rostow@, and @Burgess@ could be relevant here but the most relevant theorist is @Von Thünen@ due to his work explaining the prices of farm products in relation to patterns of land use, an area known as location theory, as @Von Thünen@ model is an early example often cited in location research
